comment: Hodierne is a great professor, and this was his first time teaching History of American Journalism. His lectures were interesting (even though some were long), and he's a pretty chill guy in general. His two projects were big, but if you plan ahead, they're easy to knock out. Easy class and a great guy.

He isan excellent professor with great personality. He is very experienced in his field and has lots of interesting stories to tell. He doesn't assigns any homework, however he wants you to do presentations for your papers. Those presentations are not very long and not very hard, however he doesn't hand out A's easily. He wants you to put effort.

Best professor I've ever had. I'm considering majoring in journalism because of him. He actively supports and encourages me in everything I do, and I've made so many connections because of him. Take him.

unbelievably smart and knows more about journalism than most people in his department. DOC1 was an amazing class and I highly suggest taking it. Not an easy A but class is always fun and you will learn a TON.

Incredible teacher, one of the most knowledgable in his field. I felt like I was taking a course from someone who deserves to be in history books. Very hard grader, but if you're a strong writer you should do fine. His journalistic career outside of teaching is fascinating.
Hands down one of the best professors I ever had. Hard grader, but if you make an effort and show you care, he will work with you. You will learn a lot. A great teacher as well as a mentor.

He refuses to give you an A. Very critical...too critical at times...seemingly forgetting that we are students and not professionals. Very annoyed with the final grade and worked way too hard to just get a B.

GREAT professor - one of the best, if not the best, journalism professor at Richmond and just an overall great guy. You can go to him about class issues or life issues. This man has seen and done a lot and calling him a friend is an honor.
Doc Journalism Class - Awesome very helpful who will teach you lots about journalism, quality video/pictures, and life. Demands much but makes you better for it.
He is hilarious but if a hard grader!!! Very meticulous which will help any Journalism major in the long run
